rationale: The original thesis remains fully intact as TU continues to consolidate tightly near the top of its daily range (95.1%) on 3.88x relative volume, showing exceptional relative strength against a weak broad market. The 5-minute 9-EMA has risen from $10.63 at entry to $10.66, keeping price well-supported above both short-term trend support and the $10.49 session VWAP while pressing within 4 cents of the $10.74 session high. With 72 minutes remaining in the session and the $10.61 invalidation level cleanly unbroken, holding maintains exposure for a potential breakout above the highs.
